notes: Account summary: Large NA fintech (card processing + lending). Primary interest: private deployment in VPC/on-prem for low-latency customer chat and document search; strong data residency needs.
Timeline (high level):
- 2025-10-12: First inbound via webinar sign-up. AE Priya assigned. Basic qualifying call; use-cases and SLO targets captured.
- 2025-11-03: Deep-dive product demo (hosted + private options). SE Luca on call. Customer asked about encryption at rest and KMS integration.
- 2025-11-10: Sent security questionnaire + SOC2/ISO evidence request. Attached RFC for on-prem package.
- 2025-12-02: Security kickoff meeting; Garnet security lead asked for our SOC2 report and ISO evidence. We provided redacted artifacts and offered an NDA/secure upload.
- 2026-01-19: Follow-up meeting noted gaps in Garnet's auditor checklist; Garnet legal said they cannot share third-party audit PDFs due to vendor policy.
- 2026-02-05: Procurement escalation; internal cost model approved but vendor security hold remains. Customer requested proof of controls mapped to their control matrix.
- 2026-02-20: Final call — Garnet decided to pause/close and evaluate competitor who offered an on-prem appliance and an in-house audit package. Marked closed-lost.

Security notes / blockers: Garnet requires vendor SOC2 Type II and ISO 27001 certificates plus a detailed control mapping to their internal framework. They explicitly stated they will only proceed if vendor provides unredacted auditor statements or full control evidence uploaded to their secure portal. Legal refuses to accept redacted artifacts.

On our side: Provided redacted SOC2 and ISO summaries, offered live walkthroughs with security team, proposed additional contractual controls (CLAs, audit clauses), suggested dedicated private deployment + customer-managed KMS. Customer declined to sign mutual NDA for auditor exchange.
Quote from security lead on 2026-01-19: 'We can't accept summaries; we need the reports or an equivalently certified third-party attestation. Our vendor policy is strict.'

Loss reason (short): Security review failed — Garnet requires unredacted audit evidence; unwilling to share vendor audit docs per our legal posture; competitor promised alternative evidence/on-prem appliance. No internal champion to push exception; procurement closed.

Next internal follow-up: Capture lessons — evaluate whether we can offer a secure, auditable upload workflow or limited-scope audit sharing. Gate: legal willingness to change redaction policy and product changes for on-prem appliance delivery.

Sales playbook notes: High security appetite customers may require dedicated legal/Security AE early; consider a templated secure evidence exchange (SFTP / VDR) and explicit NDA pre-req before questionnaire completion.
